question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：巴西 vs 摩洛哥（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Brazil vs Morocco (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 巴西实力与状态占优、摩洛哥赛前 48 小时连折两将，巴西约 58% 胜率看好，但平局与冷门不可忽视。
one_liner_en: Brazil hold the Elo and form edge while Morocco lost two squad players within 48 hours of kickoff; Brazil favoured at ~58%, with the draw and upset still live.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥开球前 48 小时内连失主力中卫 Aguerd 与边锋 Ezzalzouli（均伤退换人）
key_reasons.en: Morocco lost starting centre-back Aguerd and winger Ezzalzouli to injury within 48 hours of kickoff

key_reasons.cn: 中立场地下 164 分的 Elo 差（巴西 1991 vs 摩洛哥 1827）给出巴西明显统计优势
key_reasons.en: A 164-point Elo gap (Brazil 1991 vs Morocco 1827) at a neutral venue gives Brazil a clear statistical edge

key_reasons.cn: 巴西虽缺 Neymar（小腿伤）及 Militão/Rodrygo，但 4-3-3 主力框架已定且热身两连胜
key_reasons.en: Brazil miss Neymar (calf) plus Militao/Rodrygo, but the settled 4-3-3 won both warm-up matches

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings; bounded evidence adjustment of +3pp to Brazil (cap ±8pp) for Morocco's late injury withdrawals, partially offset by Brazil's own absences; renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
